label: J. L. Schellenberg, Précis Précis, p. 2…: At every world in the supplied domain, if God exists…
locator: Précis (2025), p. 2 premise 1; p. 4 modal clarification; p. 10 premise 1
interpretation: Attribution of the conceptual God-to-perfect-love premise. The p. 4 necessity clarification is represented by quantification over the supplied world domain. God and a perfectly loving God are existence propositions; the formalization does not infer the root first mover has personal perfection.
